label: ① 冷白索引：以排版与秩序建立平台身份
prompt:
Generate a high-fidelity DESKTOP WEBSITE HOMEPAGE comp for the real project "proof of cake", landscape 1536x1024 edge-to-edge, crisp readable UI, not a poster, no browser or device frame. This is a niche crypto-native birthday art gifting platform. Critical design problem: the PLATFORM has its own memorable, authored visual identity while the ARTWORKS have unrelated styles. Separate these rigorously. Never derive the site's materials, background or typography from one artwork. No single cinematic artwork hero, no silver-candle branding, no overall cartoon styling. Multiple artworks must coexist in the first viewport without one dominating the whole site. The attached image is an ARTWORK CONTENT REFERENCE ONLY, NOT a UI or style reference. Show its original tall ink-wash sleeping sheep composition as one clearly framed artwork; preserve its portrait aspect and recognizability, do not reinterpret the entire website as Chinese ink art. Alongside it show the same varied concept inventory: a vivid colorful pixel birthday cake, a playful colorful cartoon birthday illustration, a black-and-white architectural photograph, and an abstract colorful animation still labeled "动画". Each retains its own colors, aspect ratio, and artistic language. Do not recolor, monochromatize, crop all art to squares, or unify the artworks to match the interface. This inventory tests the platform identity. The platform remains mature, technically literate and independent in its wordmark, typographic system, spacing, navigation, selection affordances and gift controls. Real content: "挑选礼物", "生日", "生肖", "星座", "朋友的 .ai 名字", "准备这份礼物", small "设计预览，无真实交易". No invented prices, sales, editions, real-name verification, creator endorsements or commercial proof. User's ink artwork title is "今天不数羊". Other titles may be plain descriptive Chinese. Show artwork selection and the route to gift someone; no shopping-cart cliché.
Direction: WHITE INDEX. A radically precise cold-white and graphite interface, with tiny restrained electric-blue only on an actual selected state. A strong custom compact typographic wordmark and an independent typographic rhythm give the platform its character. Its composition feels like an experimental digital-art index rather than an ecommerce template: an asymmetric but rigorous multi-format artwork field with open space, consistent compact captions, and one clear selection-to-gift area. Mixed artworks inhabit the same structural system, without sacrificing their native aspect ratios. A short plain statement "选一份，像他的。" can introduce the gallery without becoming a huge marketing hero. Compact category navigation and quiet wallet utility are visibly part of the persistent platform frame. No feature cards, testimonial sections, fake metrics, decorative technical telemetry, generic three-card landing page, or illustration-derived site palette. Give this platform a recognizable graphic system that would survive replacing every picture.

label: ④ 定向赠予：以收礼身份组织页面
prompt:
Design a genuinely authored, high-fidelity desktop WEBSITE HOMEPAGE for "proof of cake", a niche crypto-native birthday art-gifting platform. Landscape 1536x1024, edge-to-edge browser content, no device or browser frame. Reference image 1 supplies ONLY the exact heterogeneous ARTWORK INVENTORY: the tall Chinese ink sheep painting, colorful pixel birthday cake, colorful cartoon birthday illustration, black-and-white architecture photo, colorful abstract animation still. Reference image 2 is the original tall sheep artwork. Do NOT preserve reference 1's generic marketplace UI, blue buttons, pill tabs, rounded SaaS chrome, grid composition or typography. Do NOT borrow the ink painting's style for the site.

New direction: THE RECIPIENT IS THE ORGANIZING IDEA. This is an art dedication system, not an NFT shop. A permanent architectural recipient lane uses a distinctive, very large sharply cut black "TO:" typographic symbol, paired with the real field label "朋友的 .ai 名字" and an empty input. This address-like structural motif and a custom compact lowercase wordmark are the platform's own enduring visual identity, independent of every artwork. Compose the remaining screen as an intentional asymmetric, multi-format artwork selection field around this recipient lane, not five identical product cards. Keep navigation minimal: "挑选礼物", "生日", "生肖", "星座", "连接钱包". Make the selected artwork and the action "准备这份礼物" obvious. Include small "设计预览，无真实交易".

Matte neutral mineral-grey ground, black type, off-white artwork surrounds only where needed, a single dark vermilion selection/action accent. No blue. Adult experimental graphic-design precision, intellectual and internet-native, emphatic spatial hierarchy, exceptional typography. All five artworks retain their own independent colors, proportions and surfaces: never recolor, unify, tint or square-crop them. The full tall sheep composition remains recognizable, title "今天不数羊". The animation has a quiet "动画" label. No invented dates, prices, trade counts, editions, names of artists, ownership or verified claims. No terminal costume, cartoon UI, huge unrelated marketing headline, physical-envelope mockup, postage stamps, faux-paper props, wireframe decoration, or glowing crypto clichés. The novelty should be the website's functional topology and its recognizable type system.
